program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to prediction chain
question: Can the already-qualified 512-motif raw-byte representation learner train directly on independently sourced external bytes and improve next-byte prediction on untouched external holdouts across code, structured data, and technical prose without tokenization or model calls?
hypothesis: Using the frozen three-source external manifest, train the exact WLM-LM-RAW-REP-PRED-FRESH-HOLDOUT-R2 512-motif learner on the first floor(0.60*N) bytes of each source pooled together and evaluate the untouched final 40% of each source separately. Supported requires every external holdout to meet the same qualified internal prediction thresholds: at least 0.04 representation coverage, at least 0.05 covered-position top-1 accuracy gain, at least 0.08 effective event reduction, and nonworse bits/byte relative to the same pooled previous-byte baseline.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_input_protocol.raw_bytes: exact SHA-256-verified fetched bytes; no decoding, parsing, normalization, tokenizer, vocabulary, or boundary tokens
frozen_input_protocol.train_split: first floor(0.60*N) bytes of each source
frozen_input_protocol.training_pool: concatenate logically as three independent files for learner counting; reset motif and previous-byte windows at source boundaries
frozen_input_protocol.evaluation: evaluate each source holdout separately; no heldout byte enters baseline counts, motif counts, ranking, capacity selection, smoothing, or threshold choice

learner.baseline: 256x256 previous-byte -> next-byte uint32 counts, lowest-byte argmax tie break, Jeffreys smoothing
learner.representation: four-byte candidate windows with occurrence >=4, ranked by best-successor count, consistency, then lexicographic raw-byte key
learner.prediction: selected motif successor distribution when matched, otherwise pooled previous-byte baseline

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and every frozen external prediction threshold pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and at least two of three external holdouts show positive covered-position gain with nonworse aggregate predictive coding, but one or more per-source frozen thresholds fail.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but fewer than two external holdouts show positive covered-position gain, or aggregate representation coding is worse than the baseline.
classification_rules.invalid: Any authority, source identity, train/holdout contamination, mechanism-equivalence, capacity, determinism, or host-isolation criterion fails.
classification_rules.incomplete: Authority, source retrieval, or hosted compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.

validity_criteria: The exact sealed Wingless state head is the parent and North Star identity matches.
A fresh CKB-plane READY_RESEARCH receipt is bound to this exact preregistration commit and frozen external manifest.
All three source SHA-256 values and exact byte lengths match before learner construction.
The scientific learner reuses the exact internal R2 baseline, candidate construction, occurrence filter, ranking, smoothing, prediction, and 512-entry capacity.
Training and evaluation windows reset at every source boundary.
No heldout byte participates in training, representation selection, capacity selection, thresholds, or stopping.
Primary execution occurs only on GitHub-hosted compute and external bytes are deleted before completion.
Full Go regression passes before the probe; duplicate complete probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, network access inside the learner, persistent corpus, capacity growth, production authority, LINKDEADKB execution, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, hashes, byte budgets, 60/40 split, learner mechanics, 512 capacity, smoothing, metrics, thresholds, controls, authority binding, or interpretation after any primary output.
